mentions.name: audioguide.london
mentions.description: Web app for gallery visitors: take a photo of an artwork and it attempts to identify it via reverse image search, returning a pre-generated audio guide and a link to the museum website. The audio guides were generated locally by feeding museum website content through an LLM to write scripts and Kokoro for text-to-speech. Originally built as a personal app about a year ago, now deployed as a website.
mentions.source_excerpt: It’s a simple image search where you take a photo of an artwork in a gallery, tries to ID it and returns a pre-generated audio and a link to the museum website.
